items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Business logic uses single-letter names (`Y1`, `Y2`, `U`, `V`, `A1`) and terse ones (`b0`, `u_0`, `offs`, `lc`, `cc`). The deeply nested vertical-filter/RGB path has almost no comments. The FFmpeg-mirroring names partly explain it, but the cap applies.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: One `src/main.zig` of about 130 KB holds everything. The process function is far over 100 lines with 4+ nesting levels. SIMD and scalar paths repeat the same ring-buffer accumulation (`row_idx % ctx.lum_ring_size` appears several times). `.zig-cache/` and `zig-out/*.so` artifacts are committed.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Fixed-point magic constants are undocumented (`1 << 18`, `>> @splat(19)`, `255`). `@intCast(y_acc >> @splat(19))` to i16 has no clamp, so overflow is possible. Some boundary checks exist, but there is no visible validation of the ring index and coefficient slice bounds.
